nodes.label: Agentic Memory (AgeMem, arXiv 2601.01885)
nodes.summary: Unified LTM+STM as tool-based actions inside the agent policy; RL-trained to decide what/when to store/retrieve/update/summarize/discard; beats separate-memory baselines on 5 long-horizon benchmarks.

nodes.label: Continuum Memory Architecture (CMA, arXiv 2601.09913)
nodes.summary: Persistent storage + selective retention + associative routing + temporal chaining + consolidation into higher-order abstractions; necessary architectural primitive for long-horizon agents; highlights drift/latency/interpretability challenges.

nodes.label: SkillsInjector (arXiv 2605.29794)
nodes.summary: Two-stage adaptive method: context planner learns execution-grounded skill preferences and admits an adaptive number of skills; set-aware renderer tailors presentation relative to neighbors.

nodes.label: Stochastic Self-Organization (ICLR 2026)
nodes.summary: Response-conditioned framework: agents generate answers, assess peer contributions via Shapley-inspired approximation, construct a DAG to route information from high-contribution agents; stable/efficient message passing without extra supervision.
